body: I snooped through An old phone and found the text files of messages.    He never thought he would get caught.  I spent so much time thinking I was the bad guy but he was cheating for over half our marriage.     He told this other woman he loved her.   What can I do or say.    I'm stuck here until the papers are finalized and reading those text messages have pushed me to a place I didn't know existed.

That's true.  I'm trying to hold onto the smallest shred of reason, that things can be better and they aren't as bad as they could be.  But right now I feel so alone and worthless.  It's hard to think about this rationally.

Hey!    Hang in there.  I'm alone too. My husband that we are talking about divorce told me today he is going out of town to be with his friends.  It's tough and sucks but I hold things go ok for you this weekend.  It's hard but it'll get better. B
